answers.M6-S1: If you really want something, like growing taller, you should try hard and follow the directions carefully, even if it takes time to work.
answers.M6-S2: Because the magic seed only works if it is kept secret. If he tells someone, the magic will break and he won't grow.
answers.M6-S3: The narrator thinks Billy is being nice and sharing his special seed. The reader might think it is strange that the seed has to be taken walking backward.
answers.M6-S4: He is worried about being short like Uncle Alec, and Billy is so tall from the seed that it seems to really work.
answers.M6-S5: Because Peg Bowen is a witch and it was scary and awful going to her house, so he doesn't want to go back.
answers.M6-S6: It shows the seed hasn't worked yet, but it has only been three days, so he still has to wait to grow.
answers.M6-S7: To show that the magic seed really works, because Billy took it and became the tallest boy his age.
answers.M6-S8: That people didn't like Billy very much, maybe not more than other people. But the narrator decides he will like him now.
answers.M6-S9: He likes his uncle a lot, but he doesn't want to be short like him. He wants to grow taller than Uncle Alec.
